newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-NANTES TURN EYE ON MADAR.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NANTES TURN EYE ON MADAR.

text.p: France striker Mickael Madar, out of favour with his Spanish club Deportivo Coruna, has become Nantes' latest target in their search for a striker.

Madar, who has also interested English premier league side Everton, is a less expensive and therefore more likely option for Nantes than Boca Juniors winger Sebastian Rambert to replace their transfer listed Argentine striker Javier Mazzoni.
Nantes, who can meet the eight million franc ($1.5 million) asking price, could be a good move for former Monaco striker Madar in his quest for a place in France's 1998 World Cup squad.
